title: Authorization lineage in RAG-derived artifacts
hypothesis: A RAG application enforcing access only at initial retrieval, without equivalent checks on cached answers or derived summaries, can return a protected synthetic marker to a denied principal after the documented authorization synchronization window.
null_hypothesis: Cached and derived responses remain scoped to the requesting principal and current source permissions in every tested case.
novelty_review: known-class local mechanism study; exhaustive survey pending

tool.name: RAG authorization lineage tester
tool.status: local prototype implemented; production adapter pending

local_hypothesis: A derived artifact must be authorized at serving time against its current source permissions, not only against the permissions used when creating it.
hypothesis_evaluation: Constructed local mechanism supported; implementation-level and population claims not established.
